score.scope: Exact normalized values within each completely annotated selected input passage. Instances match on values and sorted unique passage IDs, independently of quote offsets. Exposed, completely annotated in-catalogue spans only. Match values and unique passage IDs, with frozen timing alternatives; ignore arbitrary claim/episode IDs. Romantic pairs are symmetric; parent/guardian roles are directed. Distinct episode instances retain multiplicity; duplicates within the same episode collapse. One-to-one value matching ignores ID spelling. Ambiguous alignments maximize episode agreement, then ordering; over 4096 alternatives leaves those two scores unavailable. Raw duplicates and full-reference-span grounding are separate. Missing episode pairs fail. This conservative grounding proxy is not independent semantic/canon adjudication.

interpretation: Strict literal time and role mismatches include frozen annotation-policy differences; Phil later is explicit and Cindy in 1993 versus 1993 is not a wrong-year claim.
Full-reference-span grounding is stricter than a narrower sufficient quote; locator resolution and source support are separate.
Out-of-catalogue Laura, malformed locators and transfer of news timing to death remain observed contract/grounding/attribution failures.
Canonical graph consolidation and complete reviewed excerpts do not improve original raw extraction scores.
One valid Stacey source assertion remains explicitly superseded for same-episode compatibility; original labels and both source accounts are retained.
